meta.name: video-edit
meta.description: Edit existing video on RunComfy — this skill is a smart router that matches the user's intent to the right edit model in the RunComfy catalog. Picks Wan 2.7 Edit-Video (general restyle / background swap / packaging swap, identity + motion preservation), Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control (transfer precise motion from a reference video to a target character), or Lucy Edit Restyle (lightweight identity-stable restyle / outfit swap). Bundles each model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper edits without burning iterations on the wrong model. Calls `runcomfy run <vendor>/<model>/<endpoint>` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "video edit", "edit video", "restyle video", "swap video background", "motion control", "outfit swap video", or any explicit ask to transform a video.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你的需求自动选择最合适的视频编辑模型（Wan 2.7、Kling 2.6 或 Lucy），然后通过 RunComfy 命令行工具执行编辑，输出编辑后的视频。
howto.when: 当你提到“编辑视频”、“换背景”、“运动控制”、“换装”等与视频编辑相关的意图时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这段视频换个背景，保持人物不变。
say.note: Claude 会选用 Wan 2.7 模型执行背景替换。

say.text: 把这段参考视频的动作转移到目标人物身上。
say.note: Claude 会选用 Kling 2.6 模型进行动作迁移。

say.text: 给视频中的人物换一套职业装，保持面部不变。
say.note: Claude 会选用 Lucy 模型进行局部换装。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically selects the best video editing model (Wan 2.7, Kling 2.6, or Lucy) based on your request, then runs the edit via RunComfy CLI and outputs the edited video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention video editing intents like "edit video", "change background", "motion control", "outfit swap", etc.

say_en.text: Change the background of this video while keeping the person unchanged.
say_en.note: Claude will use Wan 2.7 for background swap.

say_en.text: Transfer the motion from this reference video to the target character.
say_en.note: Claude will use Kling 2.6 for motion transfer.

say_en.text: Change the outfit of the person in the video to business attire, keep the face.
say_en.note: Claude will use Lucy for outfit swap.
